title: Research Engineer, Biosecurity, DeepMind
descriptionHtml:
At Google, research-focused Software Engineers are embedded throughout the company, allowing them to setup large-scale tests and deploy promising ideas quickly and broadly. Ideas may come from internal projects as well as from collaborations with research programs at partner universities and technical institutes all over the world.

From creating experiments and prototyping implementations to designing new architectures, engineers work on real-world problems including artificial intelligence, data mining, natural language processing, hardware and software performance analysis, improving compilers for mobile platforms, as well as core search and much more. But you stay connected to your research roots as an active contributor to the wider research community by partnering with universities and publishing papers.

The GDM Biosecurity Initiative aims to leverage AI to proactively mitigate risks from biological threats, including those from nature or from intentional misuse of AI-enabled tools. The team conducts foundational biosecurity research across a range of topics, assists in biosecurity risk assessments of specialized science models, and engages with the broader AI biosecurity ecosystem.

As a research engineer on the biosecurity initiative, you will combine frontier ML research with software engineering best practices to build tools, models, and evaluation methodologies to mitigate biological risks. You will collaborate closely with research scientists and engineers to shape the research roadmap for the biosecurity initiative, specifically influencing data curation, scaling, infrastructure, and model development to accelerate efforts within the biosecurity portfolio aligned as required to support the initiative in collaboration with the team.

Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer diverse learning opportunities and varied career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement novel algorithms and machine-learning (ML) methods to address core biosecurity research questions.
  • Contribute to pioneering research on AI and biosecurity, supporting scientific publications and product development aligned with the Biosecurity initiative mission.
  • Collaborate with research scientists and engineers across the initiative and Science and Strategic Initiatives unit to prototype, experiment, and scale AI research using software engineering best practices.
  • Contribute to the design of biological datasets, evaluation methodologies, and infrastructure required to pursue novel research hypotheses.
  • Synthesize complex research findings into clear, actionable reports and presentations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, delivered through written documentation and verbal briefings.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with machine learning algorithms and tools (e.g., TensorFlow, Pytorch).

Preferred qualifications:

  • PhD degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Biology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience applying deep learning models to biological data (such as functional genomics or protein sequence data).
  • Experience working with life science data, such as in bioinformatics or health informatics.
  • Familiarity with emerging topics in biosecurity, such as metagenomic surveillance, de novo pathogen design, and LLM-based uplift.
  • Ability to identify, breakdown, and solve ambiguous and complex process and technical problems that span across many teams and organizations.

title: Director, Technical Program Management, Manufacturing and Industrial Engineering
descriptionHtml:
The Modular Manufacturing & Integration organization is leading an industry-defining transformation in how Google delivers technical infrastructure for the AI era. Transitioning away from conventional, on-site, purpose-built construction, our mission is to industrialize data center delivery through mass-assembled, standardized modules and off-site manufacturing.

By pushing labor-intensive assembly, systems integration, and quality testing upstream into controlled factory environments, we enable "square wave" capacity delivery—turning on gigawatt-scale AI compute, liquid cooling, power distribution, and network fabric with unprecedented velocity. Operating across AI Systems & Infrastructure (AI2), Google Data Centers (GDC), Systems & Manufacturing (ISM), and Google Global Infrastructure (GGI), our team defines the modular technical product and serves as the accountable business owner for industrializing and landing modular capacity globally.

As the Principal TPM of Manufacturing & Industrial Engineering, you will be the chief industrial architect responsible for translating Google’s modular infrastructure strategy into an executable, manufacturing reality. In this principal technical leadership role—with the charter to incubate the discipline and potentially scale a dedicated team over time—you will bridge the gap between design engineering, external contract manufacturing, and on-site field execution.

Your remit spans the entire physical and technical stack: structural modules, medium-to-low voltage power skids, liquid cooling distribution, and dense AI compute hardware. You will evaluate current field deployment and operations bottlenecks and establish scalable manufacturing processes with global contract manufacturers and fabricators. Your core mandate is simple yet radical: dramatically compress the timeline from factory gate to live AI compute, reduce complexity of assembly in manufacturing and in the field, and increase first pass yield/quality of the entire data center system.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $281000 - $391000 (USD) + 30% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Formulate and drive the multi-year manufacturing and assembly roadmap for Google’s modular data center platforms, aligning complex system architectures with industrial factory capabilities.
  • Deconstruct monolithic data center systems into standardized, manufactured building blocks. Architect module boundaries across structural, cooling, power, and IT server clusters to maximize factory pre-assembly and minimize field connections.
  • Advocate for DFM/A, Design for Test (DFT), and modular interface standards upstream across Hardware Engineering, Data Center Engineering, and Infrastructure design teams, ensuring products are engineered from inception for rapid off-site assembly.
  • Dive into existing on-site data center construction, white-space fit-out, and compute commissioning processes. Identify labor-intensive operations and re-engineer them into off-site, factory-integrated steps.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 15 years of technical program management, manufacturing engineering, or industrial engineering experience spanning integrated physical/hardware systems.
  • 10 years of experience applying Design for Manufacturing and Assembly (DFM/A), Lean Manufacturing, and process optimization to electromechanical or mission-critical systems.
  • 10 years of experience working directly with external Contract Manufacturers (CMs), Original Design Manufacturers (ODMs), or specialized industrial fabricators to stand up assembly and test lines.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations Research, or an MBA with a technical undergraduate degree.
  • 15 years of experience leading industrialization and manufacturing programs for low-to-mid volume, highly complex capital systems (e.g., aerospace systems integration, semiconductor capital equipment, specialized defense systems, complex power/propulsion plants, or modular high-performance compute clusters).
  • Deep technical literacy across both facility infrastructure (structural enclosures, liquid cooling loops, high-power distribution skids) and IT compute hardware (TPU/GPU server trays, rack-level integration, cabling topologies, and L11/L12 assembly).

As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.

As a Technical Program Manager on the Waze and Geo third-party data feeds team in Tel Aviv, you will manage the technical programs and operational systems that bring this authoritative data onto our maps accurately and at scale during a 12-month fixed-term contract. Your primary mandate in this role is to own our technical escalation program from end-to-end, reducing the operational impact of technical feed escalations by systematically offboarding routine and tier-1 troubleshooting workflows to global vendor operations teams and automating issue diagnosis and resolution wherever possible, including through generative AI and self-service diagnostic tools. Working directly alongside Waze software engineering, product management, data science, and quality assurance teams in Tel Aviv, you will evaluate real-time data feeds, analyze geospatial map-matching performance to eliminate root-cause failures, and establish clear standard operating procedures, quality metrics, and service-level agreements with vendor hubs so our maps stay fresh and reliable for communities around the world.

Waze is where people and technology meet to solve transportation challenges. It's a platform that empowers users to contribute road data and edit Waze maps to improve the way we move about the world. As the social navigation pioneer, Waze leverages mobile technology and a passionate global community to redefine expectations of today’s maps.

Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of third-party real-time geospatial data feeds (road closures, traffic, fuel prices) across Waze and Google Maps, partnering with engineering and product teams to improve feed health, map-matching accuracy, and partner reactivation.
  • Triage and diagnose technical escalations across partner feeds and map-matching pipelines, building automated triage rules, diagnostic workflows, and developer documentation to reduce recurring issues and escalation volumes.
  • Drive global vendor operations change management by establishing SOPs, SLAs, QA frameworks, and knowledge transfer plans to scale routine feed configuration, maintenance, and escalations.
  • Author program charters, phased project plans, and governance structures addressing scope, OKRs, resourcing, risks, dependencies, and postmortems while leading team meetings and managing stakeholder escalations.
  • Build trusted cross-functional and community relationships, maintaining CRM workflows, trackers, status reports, and automated dashboards to assess improvement metrics and guide program pivots.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience in program or project management.
  • Experience in data analysis and reporting.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience diagnosing parsing or map-matching errors across structured data feeds (XML, JSON, GeoJSON, Datex2, CIFS, GTFS, WZDx, ArcGIS), APIs, and ingestion pipelines, deploying workflow or generative AI automations (triage rules, self-service diagnostics, AI routing) to cut escalations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with engineering, product, and data science, authoring and reviewing PRDs, BRDs, and technical specs to validate pipeline improvements and driving agile sprints.
  • Technical partner and agency/enterprise client support, guiding onboarding, translating API and integration needs, resolving blockers, and improving feed quality.
  • Data-driven problem-solving with SQL, spreadsheets, dashboards, and funnel analysis to analyze operational metrics, pinpoint root causes of rejections or escalations, and measure impact.

title: Software Engineer Manager II, Embedded Systems/Firmware
descriptionHtml:
Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started -- and as a manager, you guide the way.

With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead software engineers developing embedded software, diagnostic tests, and tools to validate custom SoCs, servers, and SmartNICs. You will optimize system health, test performance, and solve reliability problems for millions of machines across global data centers. You will drive hardware quality decisions on designs, working on projects that push technology limits.

Your team will support critical infrastructure for machine learning, search, security, and video processing, giving you an unmatched opportunity to make a massive, global impact.

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving channel behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of software engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and collaboration. Provide regular coaching, performance feedback, and support for career development.
  • Drive the technical goal and roadmap for software, automation, and diagnostics used in machine management, health testing, and life-cycle management.
  • Lead your team's efforts in the New Product Introduction process. Ensure all newly turned up hardware is validated, properly configured, and performing as expected without defects.
  • Provide technical guidance and remain available in key areas, including system design, code reviews, and complex problem-solving.
  • Drive the development of data insights and analytics to understand complex result sets from diagnostics.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 3 years of experience with embedded operating systems.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role.
  • 2 years of experience in a people management or team leadership role.
  • Experience with embedded systems and Linux.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science, or related technical field.
  • 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Experience with ARM, Diagnostics, Networking, Servers, Linux Internals.

title: Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, Custom Silicon
descriptionHtml:
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.

In this Senior Staff Technical Program Manager (TPM) role, you will be the tactical engine and primary leader responsible for delivering Google's next-generation custom silicon. You will manage the entire lifecycle of flagship SoC programs simultaneously navigating advanced semiconductor manufacturing nodes, complex IP subsystem integration, and multi-organization hardware/software bring-up. You will blends deep semiconductor domain expertise with technical program management, excelling at bringing structure to ambiguity, managing critical paths, and driving high-velocity execution across massive cross-functional organizations.

Google's mission is to organize the world's information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team combines the best of Google AI, Software, and Hardware to create radically helpful experiences. We research, design, and develop new technologies and hardware to make computing faster, seamless, and more powerful. We aim to make people's lives better through technology.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $240000 - $333000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the single point of tactical program management for 2 concurrent SoC programs, establishing program governance and chairing formal executive phase-gate reviews, ensuring all exit criteria, technical performance metrics, and risk mitigation plans are achieved.
  • Lead cross-functional engineering orchestration across multiple functions including silicon engineering, software, product, operations, and others.
  • Orchestrate and drive end-to-end alignment of the integrated master schedule across engineering domains, proactively managing cross-functional dependencies, critical-path risks, and delivery milestones.
  • Manage and track the overall program budget in close partnership with finance, product management, and engineering leaders.
  • Act as the primary technical communication bridge to executive leadership (VPs and Directors across hardware, silicon, and operations), delivering executive dashboards, status updates, and decision tracking.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience in technical program management or engineering management leading semiconductors, ASIC, or custom SoC programs.
  • Experience driving 2 full-cycle custom SoC programs from concept through tapeout, post-silicon bring-up, qualification, and mass production.
  • Experience in the ASIC/SoC development lifecycle and terminology, including driving milestones, assessing technical risks, and communicating with specialized engineering teams.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields, or an MBA, Master’s in Engineering Management, or PMP certification.
  • 14 years of experience leading high-volume tier-1 consumer electronics SoC/ASIC programs at advanced process nodes (e.g., 5nm, 3nm, 2nm/GAA/FinFET).
  • Experience tracking program-level engineering resource requirements, budgets, and project delivery timelines in collaboration with engineering leadership, finance, product management, and other relevant stakeholder teams.
  • Experience influencing without direct authority, resolving technical trade-offs, and aligning VP-level stakeholders across hardware, silicon, and product operations.
  • Track record of strategic communication and stakeholder management across multi-functional program teams.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Accelerators Systems Platforms Software Architect
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

We co-design with hardware (HW) engineering, develop, test, help deploy and debug the software required to make accelerators work: board and chip firmware, Linux kernel drivers, hardware design simulators, integration within Google server and cluster configuration, monitoring and massive distributed systems. We are helping develop the software (SW) that power the AI hypercomputers of the AI and Machine Learning era for the Google Data Center that underpin Google Cloud offering and all Domain Specific Computation for Google internal workloads. We work on interesting systems that push the boundaries of computation -- Google servers/networks and the latest Accelerators (TPUs, GPUs, Video Transcoders and other Accelerators).

The AI and Infrastructure team is redefining what’s possible. We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. Our customers include Googlers, Google Cloud customers, and billions of Google users worldwide.

We're the driving force behind Google's groundbreaking innovations, empowering the development of our cutting-edge AI models, delivering unparalleled computing power to global services, and providing the essential platforms that enable developers to build the future. From software to hardware our teams are shaping the future of world-leading hyperscale computing, with key teams working on the development of our TPUs, Vertex AI for Google Cloud, Google Global Networking, Data Center operations, systems research, and much more.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Provide technical leadership on high-impact projects.
  • Influence and coach a distributed team of engineers.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance large-scale software solutions.
  • Serve as a TL, anchoring ownership of key systems software modules that underpin our Accelerators platforms including TPUs and other domain specific computations platforms. Be responsible for coordinating with the rest of the organization to drive the successful execution of NPI programs.
  • Interface and drive industry ecosystem engagement related to help deliver at the Speed of Light of the externalization of our TPU Accelerators platforms.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience in software development.
  • 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products.
  • 5 years of experience working with embedded operating systems.
  • Experience in development within embedded systems/firmware design and in lower-level computer systems/architecture, embedded systems, and kernel development.
  • Experience in PCI express and data center server.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.
  • 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction. 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.
  • Experience with Linux kernel (building and configuring Linux kernels for embedded systems), and understanding of kernel internals: virtual memory, interrupt handling, device drivers etc.
  • Experience in High Performance Computing and data center Networking.
  • Experience utilizing AI productivity tools to streamline individual, business or development workflows.

title: Security Engineer, Enterprise Security
descriptionHtml:
Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

As a Security Engineer on the Enterprise Identity team, you will engineer and deliver security solutions across Google's corporate and production environments. We are looking for a builder who combines security depth with an AI-first engineering mindset. In this role, you will go beyond manual reviews and policy to writing code and solving complex identity issues.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $147000 - $210000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Design, validate, and implement security controls for identity verification, credential assurance, and account lifecycle management across Alphabet's workforce.
  • Build and deploy AI-powered security tools, agentic workflows, and automated pipelines to scale risk analysis, adjudication, and security operations.
  • Design and tune data-driven detection signals, risk-tiering models, and intelligent guardrails to prevent identity fraud, synthetic impersonation, and account recovery abuse.
  • Perform security assessments, design reviews, and threat modeling for first-party identity, biometric, and authentication systems to strengthen our posture against emerging threats.
  • Partner with software engineers, product managers, and cross-functional security teams to translate complex security requirements and policy into scalable engineering solutions.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.
  • 2 years of experience with security assessments or security design reviews or threat modeling.
  • 2 years of coding experience in one or more general purpose languages.
  • Experience implementing multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, identity management, or related technologies.
  • Experience designing, implementing, and verifying security controls.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 4 years of experience in Security Engineering or Software Engineering with a security focus.
  • Experience building and deploying AI/LLM-based tools, agentic workflows, or automated pipelines to solve security, fraud, or operational engineering problems.
  • Experience with identity verification, digital identity standards (e.g., NIST SP 800-63, mDL, ePassports), biometric or hardware attestation, or IAM protocols (e.g., FIDO, WebAuthn, OIDC, SAML).
  • Experience using SQL and scripting languages to analyze security telemetry, model risk, and build data-driven fraud or abuse detections.
  • Experience communicating across engineering and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience in security engineering (e.g., identity management, network security, application security, data privacy).

title: Senior Analyst, Government Affairs and Public Policy, YouTube
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Analyst within the Government Affairs and Public Policy team at YouTube in Singapore, you will play a crucial role in supporting YouTube's policy efforts within the Asia Pacific region. You will contribute to shaping YouTube's regulatory policy strategy by coordinating with various internal teams, including Trust and Safety, Legal, Regulatory Affairs, PR, Marketing, and Product teams, as well as Google’s global Government Affairs and Public Policy team. Your role involves monitoring, analyzing, and helping to distill YouTube's perspective on important public policy challenges. You will assist in developing and implementing public policy strategies and contribute to policy positions for review by YouTube's policy and leadership teams. Your expertise will be used to support external engagement efforts and to ensure relevant and timely internal communications regarding policy developments. You will engage externally and internally on behalf of YouTube. You will need strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills to manage multiple projects and respond to policy challenges effectively. You will be part of a closely coordinated Asia Pacific team, which is part of the global YouTube Government Affairs and Public Policy team, impacting initiatives vital to YouTube's mission.

Google takes its responsibilities seriously, including engaging with government and other stakeholders on important public policy challenges. The Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team leads the company’s engagement with executive branch officials, legislators, regulators and third-parties in the formation of public policy. Working closely with Google leaders, GAPP seeks to identify key policy issues, listen carefully to others’ views and opinions, and distill and share the company’s perspective on those issues with external stakeholders. While we focus on challenges affecting the internet, our issue areas are increasingly broad and encompass many areas where public policy, business, and technology intersect.

Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyze legislative and regulatory developments across the region, providing insightful analysis and actionable recommendations to inform YouTube’s overall policy strategy and regional operational planning work.
  • Support the development and execution of core team priorities for APAC YouTube GAPP, working alongside experienced policy colleagues on executive engagement strategies and global stakeholder engagement initiatives.
  • Assist in developing presentations and materials to support cross-functional annual planning and deliver executive updates on ongoing regional and global public policy strategies across the APAC region.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional partners within and beyond GAPP, such as Communications and Marketing, to write, develop, and publish high-quality policy-related collateral and educational stakeholder resources and materials.
  • Advise product teams on policy implications during launches, while actively building and nurturing trusted relationships with policymakers, trade associations, industry partners, academics, and key non-profit group allies.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4 years of experience in policy analysis and campaigns, working on technology issues or the policy environments that surround them.
  • 4 years of experience working within government, think tanks, public interest groups, technology industry groups, or corporate public policy organizations.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 7 years of experience working on relevant policy issues within government, think tanks, public interest groups, or corporate public policy organizations.
  • Experience with internet technologies and the policy environments that surround them.
  • Knowledge of current and emerging public policy trends relating to online content platforms and technology generally.
  • Understanding of YouTube’s primary product offerings and their intersection with the public policy environment, with demonstrated experience advising and collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders to design and deliver exceptional work product.
  • Strong communicator, writer, and project manager, with the ability to operate in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment and exercise good judgment.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer III, Data Cloud, Google Cloud (English, Spanish)
descriptionHtml:
Google Cloud’s Data Cloud team builds the data platform behind Google’s agentic AI offerings: BigQuery, Managed Spark, borderless Lakehouse, Spanner, AlloyDB and Knowledge Catalog, integrated with Gemini Enterprise.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) on our Data Cloud team, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier data solutions and production-grade reality for customers. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment of complex systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Build and ship production data and machine learning workloads with customers, writing, testing, and performance-tuning PySpark, SQL, and Python on BigQuery, Managed Spark, Spanner, and AlloyDB.
  • Stand up working proofs with customers’ data, including de-identifying sensitive data (e.g., PCI, PHI).
  • Build the data foundation for agentic solutions, including lakehouse architectures, metadata and semantic context, and the access controls that let custom agents act on trusted data.
  • Train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning and agentic components where they improve the customer’s business metric, with evaluation and monitoring in place.
  • Refactor and migrate high-cost analytics, Spark, and operational database workloads from other platforms onto Google Cloud engines, with measured price-performance results.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, solution architecture, machine learning, or technical consulting, including experience writing code in Python and SQL.
  • Experience with data cloud ecosystem products, technologies, or languages (e.g., Apache Spark, PySpark, BigQuery, Spanner, AlloyDB).
  • Experience taking production-grade data cloud solutions from conception to launch, architecting data systems on cloud platforms (GCP), and building structured/unstructured pipelines.
  • Experience training, evaluating, and deploying machine learning models in production.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Spanish fluently to collaborate with regional teams.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience building LLM applications (e.g., Gemini, RAG, vector search) and multi-agent frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) using advanced patterns (ReAct, delegation).
  • Experience with GCP data products (BigQuery, Spark, Spanner, Dataplex) or equivalents (Databricks, Snowflake), and open table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake).
  • Experience migrating analytics, Spark, or database workloads between platforms with measured cost and performance outcomes.
  • Skilled in prompt engineering, model evaluation, LLM-native metrics (latency, tokens/sec, cost), state management, and granular tracing.

title: Program Manager III, Spares Management, Data Center Equipment

title: Senior Staff UX Model Designer
descriptionHtml:
At Google, we follow a simple but vital premise: "Focus on the user and all else will follow." Google’s Conversation Designers leverage their knowledge of human language and communication to create seamless and natural interactions for digital systems across surfaces.

Google User Experience (UX) is made up of multi-disciplinary teams of UX Designers, Researchers, Writers, Content Strategists, Program Managers, and Engineers: we care deeply about the people who use our products. The UX team plays an integral part in gathering insights about the attitudes, emotions, and behaviors of people who use our products to inspire and inform design. We collaborate closely with each other and with engineering and product management to create industry-leading products that deliver value for the people who use them, and for Google’s businesses.

As a Conversation Designer, you’ll create conversational, voice-forward experiences across multiple surfaces, such as smart speakers, smart displays, auto, and more. You’ll work on multiple projects simultaneously, deal with cross-functional stakeholders, and provide feedback and direction to design work. Design work will include understanding product requirements and user context, and you’ll create flows, prompts, and multi-modal interaction patterns.

We're shaping the future of enterprise AI. Our UX team crafts intuitive experiences for Gemini for Enterprise and Gemini Platform, empowering people to completely redefine how work gets done. As a UX Model Designer, you'll bridge content design and model design: you'll write the behavior spec, golden answers, and system instructions, then turn them into rubrics, evals, and training data that show whether responses meet the bar and move them toward it.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $236000 - $329000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Define the voice and behavior spec for Gemini Enterprise and hold every model we offer to it through system instructions, context, and routing.
  • Write golden answers and turn subjective qualities like tone and length into rubrics that human raters and autoraters can score.
  • Partner with research and engineering to calibrate autoraters and get the spec, golden answers, and preference data into evals and training pipelines.
  • Analyze eval results, loss patterns, and user feedback for each model, then revise the spec and design feedback mechanisms with UX.
  • Align content design, research, product, and engineering on one product voice, and mentor designers in model design.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

descriptionHtml:

Beam is an AI-first 3D video communication platform developed by Google that enables remote conversations to feel like natural, in-person interactions. Formerly known as Project Starline, Beam combines advanced AI volumetric video modeling, spatial audio, and light-field display technology to provide lifelike depth, perspective, and eye contact without requiring headsets or 3D glasses. The team operates in a fast-paced environment handling complex challenges across real-time computing, machine perception, and hardware-software co-design.

As a Engineer on Android System and Frameworks, you will drive low-level platform architecture across the Android stack, bridging custom hardware with upper-layer system services. You will deliver low-latency, power-efficient, and robust platform software across custom Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) interfaces (AIDL/HIDL), framework extensions, and runtime performance profiling, owning the foundational software powering the Beam experience.

Labs is a group focused on incubating early-stage efforts in support of Google’s mission to organize the world’s information and make it universally accessible and useful. Our team exists to help discover and create new ways to advance our core products through exploration and the application of new technologies. We work to build new solutions that have the potential to transform how users interact with Google. Our goal is to drive innovation by developing new Google products and capabilities that deliver significant impact over longer timeframes.

Preferred qualifications:

title: Software Engineer III, YouTube, Content ID Claiming
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. The team is the central decision engine for Content ID, YouTube’s world-leading rights management platform. The team builds and operates the complex, real-time pipeline that orchestrates a suite of upstream signals from classic audio/visual fingerprinting to facial, speech and generative biometrics (e.g., LikenessID), as well as complex fictional and universe tracking (e.g., CharacterID). The team computes the authoritative, final claiming verdicts at a massive scale.
At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

Responsibilities

  • Leverage multi-modal signals (e.g., visual/audio/melody matching) to generate highly accurate content claims.
  • Identify unauthorized Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) reuse of human likeness (e.g., facial/voice), animated characters and fictional universes alongside classical copyright.
  • Detect Content ID bypass tricks and identify bad references used for illicit monetization while protecting innocent creators.
  • Build, run and maintain both our core quality systems and the underlying infrastructure that powers them.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Familiarity or strong interest in signal processing, machine learning frameworks or biometric classification workflows.

title: Administrative Business Partner, Partnership Solution (Japanese)

title: User Experience Engineer Intern, PhD, Summer 2027

title: Kỹ sư quản lý độ tin cậy của phần cứng, Nhóm Pixel
descriptionHtml:
Khi đảm nhận vai trò kỹ sư về độ tin cậy, bạn sẽ góp phần quan trọng vào việc tạo ra các sản phẩm điện tử tiêu dùng mới, đáp ứng tiêu chuẩn cao về độ tin cậy và hiệu suất. Bạn sẽ phối hợp chặt chẽ cùng các nhóm kỹ thuật thiết kế và quản lý sản phẩm để xác định tiêu chuẩn, chỉ định quy trình kiểm thử, sau đó giám sát quá trình kiểm thử và phân tích lỗi. Đồng thời, bạn sẽ cần sử dụng chuyên môn kỹ thuật sâu rộng và vận dụng thành thạo các phương pháp thống kê cho quá trình thiết kế sản phẩm mới. Kỹ năng giao tiếp và diễn đạt tốt là yếu tố then chốt giúp đảm bảo những đề xuất kỹ thuật mà bạn đưa ra sẽ được áp dụng.

Đồng hành với Google trong sứ mệnh sắp xếp thông tin của thế giới, Nhóm thiết bị và dịch vụ sẽ kết hợp những điểm ưu việt nhất trong công nghệ AI của Google, phần mềm và phần cứng để tạo ra những trải nghiệm hữu ích vượt trội. Trong sứ mệnh này, Nhóm độ tin cậy của hệ thống điện thoại Pixel mang đến độ bền và chất lượng phần cứng vượt trội trong suốt vòng đời của sản phẩm Pixel.

Sứ mệnh của Google là sắp xếp thông tin của thế giới và giúp thông tin đó trở nên hữu ích và dễ tiếp cận trên toàn cầu. Nhóm thiết bị và dịch vụ của chúng tôi kết hợp những điểm ưu việt nhất trong công nghệ AI, phần mềm và phần cứng của Google để tạo ra những trải nghiệm hữu ích vượt trội cho người dùng. Chúng tôi nghiên cứu, thiết kế và phát triển các công nghệ và phần cứng mới để mang đến cho người dùng trải nghiệm điện toán nhanh hơn, liền mạch hơn và mạnh mẽ hơn. Dù là tìm ra những cách mới để ghi lại và nhận biết thế giới xung quanh, cải tiến kiểu dáng thiết bị hay đổi mới cách thức tương tác, Nhóm thiết bị và dịch vụ đều hướng đến mục tiêu cải thiện cuộc sống của mọi người bằng công nghệ.

Responsibilities

  • Diễn dịch các mục tiêu về độ tin cậy trong quy trình quản lý sản phẩm thành những mục tiêu phù hợp và có thể kiểm thử.
  • Thực hiện quy trình phân tích dữ liệu thống kê, kiểm tra tuổi thọ cấp tốc (ALT) và lập mô hình, cũng như đánh giá rủi ro.
  • Duy trì những mối quan hệ quan trọng với các đối tác là nhà sản xuất theo hợp đồng (CM), phòng thử nghiệm và nhóm nội bộ. 
  • Thúc đẩy quy trình phân tích lỗi đối với mọi lỗi phát hiện được trong quá trình kiểm thử độ tin cậy, dẫn dắt các phòng ban liên ngành nội bộ và bên ngoài để điều hành quy trình này.
  • Phát triển và triển khai kế hoạch kiểm thử, lên kế hoạch và quản lý nguồn lực (ví dụ: nguồn lực và trang thiết bị nội bộ cũng như bên ngoài), đồng thời tổng hợp và trình bày báo cáo. Quản lý độ tin cậy của sản phẩm từ giai đoạn làm nguyên mẫu cho đến hết vòng đời.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bằng cử nhân ngành kỹ thuật phần cứng hoặc kinh nghiệm thực tế tương đương.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển sản phẩm phần cứng tiêu dùng.
  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm kiểm thử sản phẩm phần cứng.

Preferred qualifications:

  • 2 năm kinh nghiệm vận dụng các kỹ thuật thiết kế đảm bảo độ tin cậy.
  • Có kiến thức về các tiêu chuẩn kiểm thử trong ngành (JEDEC, ASTM, IEEE).
  • Có kỹ năng phân tích và tổ chức xuất sắc, tỉ mỉ đến từng chi tiết, có năng lực và cam kết hoàn thành công việc đúng tiến độ với độ chính xác cao.
  • Có kỹ năng giao tiếp hiệu quả và thái độ sẵn sàng hành động.
  • Là một kỹ sư tỉ mỉ, có khả năng giải quyết vấn đề xuất sắc.

title: Manager Data Center Execution Engineering, Global Data Centers
descriptionHtml:
Our thirst for technology is a part of everything we do. The Data Center Engineering team takes the physical design of our data centers into the future. Our lab mirrors a research and development department -- cutting-edge strategies are born, tested and tested again. Along with a team of great minds, you take on complex topics like how we use power or how to run state-of-the-art, environmentally-friendly facilities. You're a visionary who optimizes for efficiencies and never stops seeking improvements -- even small changes that can make a huge impact. You generate ideas, communicate recommendations to senior-level executives and drive implementation alongside facilities technicians.

Through your leadership, you use your technical expertise to lead cross-functional teams to develop infrastructure improvements. You manage a team of engineers and assign Googlers to projects based on their capabilities and the project's demands.

As a Manager of Data Center Engineering (Execution Engineering), you will lead the end-to-end delivery of hyperscale infrastructure, overseeing civil, structural, geotechnical, and water/wastewater systems from site due diligence, design through final commissioning and supporting Operations. You will act as the technical authority, collaborating with cross-functional teams, external A/E partners, and general contractors to ensure projects are delivered safely, on schedule, and within budget. You will also manage a group of experienced engineers: civil, structural, geotech water and waste water.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $214000 - $298000 (USD) + 25% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the execution and delivery of civil, structural, geotechnical, and water/waste water infrastructure for global data center campus developments from site intake to operational handover.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil/Structural Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

  • Knowledge of water/wastewater design, hydraulic modeling, and industry construction means and methods.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team environment and communicate technical issues effectively in written and verbal forms, with special consideration given to online collaboration and presentations.

title: Staff Forward Deployed Engineer, GenAI, Google Cloud
descriptionHtml:
As a Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) Forward Deployed Engineer at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder who bridges the gap between frontier Artificial Intelligence (AI) products and production-grade reality within customer environments. You will function as a builder-consultant, moving beyond architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions. You will solve the integration complexities, data readiness, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. You will serve a dual purpose: providing "white glove" deployment and acting as a critical feedback loop for Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the discovery-to-deployment journey, serving as the lead developer for AI applications and transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems and MCP servers) that drive measurable return on investment.

  • Engineer for production excellence, building high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet the requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Experience building full-stack solutions that interface with enterprise systems.

  • Experience architecting AI systems on cloud platforms.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
  • Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and patterns like ReAct, self-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.

title: Engineering Manager, Applied AI, Cloud Support Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Google Cloud’s mission is to make every business successful through AI by combining cutting-edge technology, infrastructure, and talent. AI/ML software engineers in Cloud bridge the gap between pioneering models and a massive product vehicle reaching billions. Our talent density and AI-powered tools drive rapid development, rooted in a culture of empowerment and a bias to action. In this role, you aren’t just building technology; you’re shaping the frontier of enterprise and driving the evolution of advanced models.

Google Cloud is experiencing rapid growth, and scaling traditional support linearly is no longer sustainable. The Cloud Support Platform (CSP) Intelligence team is supporting Google Cloud’s transformation into an AI-first, agentic support ecosystem across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Google Workspace (GWS), Billing, and Cloud Helpdesk.

Our mission is to deliver frictionless, agentic support at scale—turning every customer interaction into instant, zero-touch resolution or elevated human-steered troubleshooting, while continuously feeding insights back to self-heal Google Cloud products. We build and operate the core AI Layer powering Google Cloud Support: multi-agent self-service agents , ubiquitous headless intake agents embedded directly into developer workflows (Cloud Console, IDEs, Slack), stateful human-in-the-loop AI Agents, and continuous learning pipelines backed by rigorous automated evaluation.

Joining CSP Intelligence means leading at the frontier of applied enterprise GenAI—solving complex multi-agent orchestration, high-reliability (99.99%) distributed systems, and real-time reasoning challenges that directly impact millions of Google Cloud developers, enterprise administrators, and support engineers worldwide.

Our work is measured in outcomes the business feels directly — deflection rate, time-to-resolution, average handle time, and customer effort.

The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real-world impact, aiming to push the state-of-the-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real-world impact that benefits our customers.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $207000 - $300000 (USD) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.

  • Set technical direction for multi-agent architecture, orchestration, tool/skill design, and evaluation in an area where the platform landscape is still being decided — and make the calls on what we build, what we adopt, and what we retire.
  • Drive measurable business outcomes: self-service deflection rate, time-to-resolution, average handle time, and customer effort score — and define the metrics and evaluation harnesses that prove it.
  • Build the quality bar for applied AI: systematic evals, regression gates, and safe rollout practices for agents that take real actions on customer accounts.

  • Master's degree or PhD in related field.

title: AI Sales Specialist, Google Cloud

title: Staff Software Engineer, Persistent Disk Snapshot Team
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Persistent Disk (PD) Snapshot team delivers foundational data protection and disaster recovery solutions for Google Cloud’s Persistent Disk (PD). We are responsible for PD Snapshots and Instant Snapshots-critical backup primitives ensuring business continuity for global enterprises. While standard PD Snapshots offer highly durable, geo-redundant storage in Google Cloud Storage (GCS), Instant Snapshots provide ultra-fast, in-place checkpoints for rapid recovery. Our mission is to build the most reliable, scalable, and high-performance data protection infrastructure in the cloud, helping customers seamlessly guard against data loss with minimal downtime.

In this role, you will manage distributed storage and metadata challenges at exabyte scale, directly impacting the reliability and trustworthiness of Google Cloud Platform for millions of users worldwide.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a critical technical leader setting the strategy, roadmap, and architectural direction for Google Cloud's backup and disaster recovery primitives.
  • Be responsible for managing large, highly ambiguous problems where the path forward is unclear, reducing chaos, and building consensus across multiple cross-functional teams.

title: Manager, AI and Infrastructure Strategic Initiatives (Mandarin, English)
descriptionHtml:

We empower Google customers with breakthrough capabilities and insights by delivering AI and Infrastructure at unparalleled scale, efficiency, reliability and velocity. title: MBA Intern, Summer 2027
descriptionHtml:
*This internship program is intended for students that are pursuing a Master’s in Business Administration in year one of the program, depending on their program and unique circumstances.

Our MBA Internship Program is a paid internship that will immerse you into the tech industry on a high-impact team. You’ll enhance your skill set, be challenged with rigorous work, grow your network and drive meaningful change in our business.

Outside of your core work, you will participate in a high-touch program that exposes you to Google’s business operations, connects you with interns and Googlers, and invests in your personal and professional development. You may pick up a new technical skill, while also building a relationship with a 1:1 mentor and hearing from company leadership through a unique speaker series.

Interns will be considered for potential full-time opportunities in their host organizations based on their internship performance and business need.

Role Areas:

MBA interns are placed on teams across the business according to their background and skills. To explore our primary fields of work and review common participating teams, please visit our Student Hub page. While participating hiring teams vary each year, the key role profiles typically included are outlined below:

Business Strategy & Operations: Deliver the analytical insights our leaders use to enable us to innovate. Whether it’s identifying acquisitions and investments, generating business strategies for products, or developing partners in emerging markets such as Africa and India, Business Strategy Googlers anticipate opportunities and execute programs critical to Google’s short- and long-term growth.

Finance: Fuel our moonshots by devising innovative solutions to complex problems in forecasting, accounting, compliance, and project management. From advising our product teams to managing day-to-day balance sheets, you’ll help keep our business on track to meet (or, better yet, exceed) our goals.

People Operations: Empowering the people who are building the future of AI. Our People Operations team are the strategists and culture-builders who ensure our colleagues can thrive in an AI-powered world. By blending data-driven strategy with a deep focus on the employee experience, we are dedicated to building an extraordinary workplace, designing the future of work, and supporting Google's AI-powered transformation. We’re not just an HR team; we are the architects of the culture that will lead Google's next chapter.

Program Management: Overseeing day-to-day progress on large-scale projects, owning planning, execution, and communications, Program Managers play a critical role across various product areas and functions across Google, from Cloud to Platform & Devices, and beyond.

Product Management: You’re a curious and collaborative visionary, someone excited about solving the hard problems in technology. Google is and always will be a company that thinks big and takes risks. Architect the future of our products by bridging engineering and business as you manage a product's full lifecycle, from strategic planning to development and launch. Computer science and coding experience required in order to be considered.

Sales, Service & Support: Turn product innovations into vital client solutions. The backbone of Google’s success, the account managers, consultants and analysts in these roles are all dedicated to top-notch client service. Whether negotiating with Fortune 500 companies, solving technical challenges for small businesses, or surfacing product ads in just the right place, we develop new business opportunities while increasing the use of our product offerings.

Corporate Development: You work collaboratively across functions to identify, evaluate, and negotiate both acquisition and strategic investment opportunities. You understand the industry landscape and regional nuances, and provide the management team with the needed insight to drive intelligent, sound decision-making.

Google Public Sector: You'll partner with government and education to drive innovation, enhance security, and implement cutting-edge cloud and AI solutions. From enhancing citizen services to protecting national security, you’ll build impactful solutions that make a difference in millions of lives.


Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

title: Network Implementation Engineer
descriptionHtml:

You also ensure that network operations are safe and efficient by monitoring network performance, coordinating planned maintenance, adjusting hardware components and responding to network connectivity issues. Keeping the network reliable ensures that our users stay connected with our suite of applications, products and services.

In this pivotal leadership role, you will drive the successful and scalable deployment of Google’s large-scale networking solutions within their assigned region in North America. As an ideal applicant, you will possess a deep understanding of the large-scale networking landscape, coupled with a proven track record of driving business process innovation that accelerates network delivery at scale. You will work within complex data center environments and a strong background in network technologies are essential.

title: Director, Engineering, Compute Infrastructure, Google Distributed Cloud
descriptionHtml:
Google Distributed Cloud (GDC) is a cloud-centric platform that enables enterprises to run modern apps anywhere consistently at scale. We offer a wide spectrum of solutions from managed software on your own hardware, fully managed hardware and AI-led software services, to completely air-gapped sovereign offerings.

As Director of Engineering for Compute Infrastructure in GDC Services, you will lead a foundational engineering organization responsible for the core compute infrastructure that power Google Distributed Cloud.

This role gives you direct ownership of:

  1. The bedrock for sovereign AI: Your compute stack provides the high performance, confidential, and resilient substrate upon which Google’s flagship services, including on-prem Gemini, Vertex AI, autonomous agentic runtimes, are built, scheduled, and executed at scale.

  2. A flagship customer facing surface: Your organization owns the end to end compute infrastructure surface (APIs, CLI, UI, workload lifecycle, and multi-tenancy) that sovereign customers interact with daily to operate their most mission critical VM fleets.

As the Director of Engineering for Compute Infrastructure in Google Distributed Cloud, you will define the multi year technical vision and product execution roadmap across connected, edge, and fully disconnected airgapped topologies. Partnering with Product Management, SRE, Systems/Hardware Engineering, Security, and Google DeepMind/Cloud AI, you will establish a robust and resilient compute foundation engineered for the highest security boundaries in the world (FedRAMP, IL5, ITAR, Sovereign Controls).

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Solve one of the greatest infrastructure transitions in enterprise IT, giving customers a modern alternative to legacy virtualization stacks without requiring them to rewrite decades of enterprise VM applications.

Drive hardware and GPU utilization, NUMA aware scheduling, SR-IOV, GPU passthrough, and confidential computing to unlock maximum price-performance and zero-trust security.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic, Optimization, Recursive Self-Improvement
descriptionHtml:
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer to help our efforts in Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI), Automated Prompt Optimization (APO), and Agentic prompt simplification. We are working towards ensuring that multimodal journeys in Search are fully onboarded onto RSI, and we also motivate horizontal improvements across Search from our learnings.

In this role, you will help set and execute the technical direction as part of a strong team for autonomous, closed-loop agentic systems that continuously optimize, compress, and modularize system instructions and agent trajectories—improving instruction-following fidelity, reasoning quality, and inference efficiency at scale.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Learn more about benefits at Google.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate and build automated multi-agent systems that audit, compress, and de-conflict complex model context—maximizing token efficiency and inference speed while preserving behavioral and safety guardrails.
  • Bridge inference-time context engineering with model post-training (SFT/RL) to distill complex rules into model weights.
  • Advance automated optimization methods for production multimodal and reasoning systems.
  • Help define the multi-quarter roadmap across Engineering and Research teams, establishing rigorous automated evaluation gates.

title: Technical Program Manager, Privacy, Consent and Personalization, Search
descriptionHtml:

We protect user data by default, building privacy rules into the platform so data is only used, kept, and deleted in promised ways. This lowers regulatory risk, gives users visibility and control, turns complex global regulations into simple, consistent experiences, and cuts duplicated effort to run efficiently at Google scale.

As a Search Data Protection Technical Program Manager, you will shape and execute our data protection strategy across Search. Additionally, you will identify and analyze risks associated with sensitive data handling, developing mitigation strategies and driving remediation efforts. Finally, you will define and track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to measure program effectiveness, communicate progress to leadership, and stay informed about evolving regulations to adapt our compliance approach.

title: GSOC Supervisor
descriptionHtml:

You'll collaborate with our Facilities Management team to create innovative security strategies, investigate breaches and create risk assessment plans for the future. You believe that providing effective security doesn't come at the expense of customer service - you will be our bodyguard (and our long lost pal).

The Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) is GSRS’s 24/7 ecosystem to Detect, Triage, and Respond to threats to Alphabet.

The GSOC actively manages an incredibly broad and volatile threat landscape. This includes responding to regional conflict, Tier 1 events, navigating disruption from geopolitical instability and large-scale external actors like protest and direct action. Internally, our focus is hardening against insider risk, workplace violence and the rising cases of concerning behavior and complex needs among vulnerable Googlers.

The GSOC is committed to a future as an industry standard SOC organization, cementing our role as the central coordination function for all GSRS Operations. We execute this goal through operational excellence, exceptional technology, mature programs and fielding the best people GSRS has to offer. Leadership, competence and adaptability drive our strategy, and enable GSOC to meet the evolving threat and the demands of the enterprise.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Site Reliability Engineering, Google Distributed Cloud
descriptionHtml:

SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

The Google Distributed Cloud SRE team is reshaping how reliability is delivered for one of Google’s most unique platforms. GDC is a bundled hardware and software solution designed to meet the most stringent sovereignty requirements. Because our customers operate these environments themselves, our SRE team has a unique mission: we engineer reliability directly into the product life-cycle.

Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.

Responsibilities

  • Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews.
  • Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.
  • Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
  • Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.
  • 3 years of experience leading projects.
  • 3 years of experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in Linux/UNIX internals and core networking concepts (e.g., TCP/IP, routing, load balancing, SDN).
